rawBlockNode.name: story-copy
rawBlockNode.content: With almost one century of experience and a research and development department that continuously studies and works on new technologies, PAMA develops and manufactures boring machines, milling machines and machining centres for various sectors for which it guarantees quality and reliability.

rawBlockNode.name: story-card-0-body
rawBlockNode.content: Processing of hard materials for the aerospace sector.

rawBlockNode.name: story-card-1-body
rawBlockNode.content: Precision and repeatability for energy applications.

rawBlockNode.name: story-card-2-body
rawBlockNode.content: Flexible, reliable solutions for transport components.

rawBlockNode.content: One Italian story, over 90 years of machine-tool expertise.

rawBlockNode.content: PAMA is proud of its many years of experience in the field of machine tools and provides its customers with a wide range of services and contracts to ensure the sustained highest level of performance of its products.
